sources.access_notes: Use as an external campaign handoff unless supported partner access is obtained.

sources.name: Groover
sources.access_notes: Official materials describe guaranteed feedback and multiple music-industry verticals.
sources.pricing_observed: 2 Grooviz per standard contact; 1 Grooviz equals EUR 1
sources.next_action: Explore partner access and support campaign preparation plus outcome logging.

sources.name: Feedspot Media Contact Database
sources.coverage_claim: 500000 Instagram, 100000 TikTok, 150000 YouTube, and 220000 blog records advertised
sources.access_notes: Broad marketing datasets may overlap and are not inherently music-specific.
sources.next_action: Request music-specific sample, license, collection basis, freshness evidence, and duplicate metrics.

sources.name: !earshot Distro
sources.coverage_claim: Canadian campus and community radio network
sources.access_notes: Public records include preferred genres, formats, submission methods, instructions, and dates.
sources.pricing_observed: CAD 7 per song or CAD 50 per album for uploads
sources.next_action: Prototype a review-only radio importer with eligibility and freshness fields.

sources.name: The Sync Report
sources.coverage_claim: 400+ music supervisors plus TV, film, brand, agency, and studio contacts
sources.access_notes: Paid access. Do not redistribute records without license rights.
sources.next_action: Request terms covering internal CRM storage, evidence retention, and multi-workspace access.

sources.name: Indie on the Move

sources.name: FestivalNet

sources.name: The Unsigned Guide
